harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured persistent, source-restricted SNMPv2c monitoring from node2 to node1. System identity, uptime, location, and contact are readable; writes are rejected. Both nodes were restarted individually and recovered with changed boot identities. The OS/kernel remained unchanged and the asset register’s SHA-256 hash is preserved.
actions_performed: Installed signed RHEL 10 net-snmp packages without disabling signature verification.
Configured snmpd on node1 for the requested read-only community, restricted to node2 and the system OID subtree.
Restricted UDP/161 through firewalld to node2 only.
Enabled snmpd at boot and retained the vendor configuration as root-only rollback material.
Verified remote reads and explicit write rejection before and after restarts.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified boot identity changes and recovery.

evidence.requirement: SNMPv2c access from node2 exposes system identity, uptime, contact, and location
evidence.summary: Direct node2 queries returned sysDescr, sysUpTime, sysContact=ops@branch.test, sysName=node1, and sysLocation=West Branch.

evidence.requirement: Community permits reads but rejects writes
evidence.summary: SNMP SET attempts returned noAccess with nonzero status, while the location remained unchanged before and after both restarts.
snmpd is enabled and active, bound to node1’s managed address, configuration is root-only, no writable community exists, and firewalld permits UDP/161 only from node2.
The asset register retained SHA-256 da19717ac6440a3f765b43e60902dc7670b3d3ef133daa4a009a5f726fc6509a and its original contents.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel preserved
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 after the changes and restarts.
Healthy baseline boot ID 22045032-4379-47d6-bbf6-319fdca89750 changed to 388714fa-2d5d-4f7b-b0cf-d68c9da4e825. snmpd, firewalld, listener, asset data, remote reads, and write denial recovered.
Healthy baseline boot ID 050a5b4c-6c7b-42ad-957a-b6a41a0d34db changed to b7406e3f-ed2b-46ae-b8bd-ef98fb5c5e66. The monitoring client package and full read/write-rejection behavior recovered.
